description: Quantitative risk metrics for any ERC-20 token: holder concentration (top 10 holder %), contract permissions (can mint/burn/pause/blacklist), liquidity depth vs market cap, deployer history, and weighted composite risk score (0-100). Pre-computed for top tokens, live-computed for others. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.
name: token_risk_metrics
